newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil TBC rate cut to 1.82 pct in October - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil TBC rate cut to 1.82 pct in October - paper.

text.p: Brazil's Monetary Policy Committee (Copom) has cut October's Basic Interest Rate of the Central Bank (TBC) to 1.82 percent, newspapers said.
In September, the TBC rate was 1.88 percent.
The new TBC surprised the market, which means that a drop in interbank interest rates is likely to happen, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper said.
The Copom also set the first Rate of Assistance of the Central Bank (TBAN) at 1.93 percent, newspapers said.
The TBC and TBAN are used as reference rates for Central Bank rediscount loans.
